com.eloview.homesdk.networkManager

Class ESTConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.eloview.homesdk.networkManager.ESTConfig
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    android.os.Parcelable

    public class ESTConfig
extends java.lang.Object
implements android.os.Parcelable
    EstConfig class contains the certificate details, which is required for EST Certificate to installation.

    It consist below information.
    For e.g.

    • url : 192.168.2.1
    • port : 8085
    • alias : test
    • estUsername : username
    • estPassword : password
    • certificateFilePath : /sdcard/certificate.pem
